unlisted_practices: Distilling structured agentic trajectories from frontier models into a small on-premise multimodal model to reduce cost, latency, and privacy risk
Three-tier stratified supervision for difficulty-aware strategy selection between direct reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent interaction

screen.reason: The paper presents Meissa, a new multimodal medical agent architecture/model trained on trajectory distillation, and evaluates its accuracy/efficiency across 13 medical benchmarks. It develops a new model rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
